Pattern x starts at 4 and adds 6. Pattern y starts at 2 and adds 3. Each term in pattern y is what fraction of the corresponding term in pattern x? Choices: A) 2 | B) 3 | C) 1/2 Answer with the letter only.
Solution: Correct answer: C (1/2). The starting value 2 is half of 4, and each increase of 3 is half of 6, so each y term is half of the corresponding x term.

A rule says subtract 9 from x to get y. Which ordered pair follows the rule Choices: A) (9,1) | B) (4,13) | C) (13,4) Answer with the letter only.
Solution: Correct answer: C ((13,4)). Since 13 − 9 = 4, (13,4) follows the rule. For (9,1), 9 − 9 = 0, not 1; for (4,13), 4 − 9 = −5, not 13.
